visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a street-level shot of the 'Hung Master' restaurant storefront. A bright red banner with white text hangs above the entrance, and several motorbikes are parked in front. (2) A close-up shot shows a hand using black chopsticks to lift bright orange sea urchin from a small blue-patterned ceramic bowl. (3) The scene shifts to a large metal hotpot on an induction stove, surrounded by plates of raw meat, noodles, and dumplings. (4) A metal ladle pours a clear, golden broth into the pot, showing the liquid's texture. (5) The sea urchin from the small bowl is poured directly into the simmering broth. (6) A raw whole lobster on a decorative plate is shown, followed by a shot of cooked lobster meat being held by metal tongs. (7) Sliced raw beef or pork is presented on a rectangular plate, showcasing the marbling. (8) Raw scallops and several grey shrimp are added to the pot; a subsequent shot shows the shrimp turned bright orange after cooking. (9) A person pours clear liquid from a whole, opened green coconut into a different pot containing chicken and goji berries. (10) Slices of crispy, golden-brown scallion pancakes and dark, fried pork ribs are displayed on black plates. (11) The camera pans across the interior of the restaurant, revealing clean wooden tables, chairs, and white walls with decorative paintings. (12) The final shot returns to the restaurant exterior and signboards during the day.
